title: Algebraic Stories — Generic $k$-rank
exact_target: Determine how many powers of degree-$d$ complex forms are needed for a general degree-$kd$ form in any number of variables.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1500001 (AMR-014-0001). CC BY 4.0.
